text: Illustrate the story here: Catching Fish Kate and Mitch wanted to do something fun. Kate hatched a thrilling plan. She snatched a bucket and some poles from the hutch. "Let's go!" Kate yelled. Kate and Mitch went to the lake beyond the ditch. "Let's catch some fish," Kate calls out. Mitch catches a fish! They pitch it in the bucket. "Nice catch! Let's get this fish back home," said Kate. At home, Kate and Mitch toss the fish into their pond. "This fish can be our pet!" said Kate.
